# Cat, phase 4 (run with --no-save on cat_fit.rmdl): the game's parts. The body (torso, head,
# ears, eyes, muzzle), the tail with its origin at its root (the game sways it) and one leg with
# its paw with its origin at the hip (four copies in the scene, swung by the game); each part's
# pivot moved to the world origin so the bake entry's position is the pivot. Generated by make_cat.py.
select TailA TailB TailC
active TailA
join
rename TailA Tail
cursor set 0.0 0.44 0.55
origin set --to cursor
set location 0 0 0
select Leg0 Paw0
active Leg0
join
cursor set -0.13 -0.13 0.34
origin set --to cursor
set location 0 0 0
select Tail
export cat_tail.glb --selection
select Leg0
export cat_leg.glb --selection
select Torso Head Muzzle EarL EarR EyeL EyeR
export cat_body.glb --selection
